response.evidence: Analysis of loan outcomes by race and sex shows White males have an approval rate of approximately 95.2% (922 approved out of 968 applications). This approval rate is consistent with or slightly higher than other demographic groups in the dataset. White females show 94.8% approval, Hispanic or Latino applicants show 94.1% approval, and Asian applicants show 95.4% approval. The applicant's rejection appears to be based on standard underwriting criteria (loan amount, debt-to-income ratio, loan-to-value ratio, income, property value) rather than race or sex. No statistical pattern of systematic discrimination against White males is evident in this data.
